name: Witch Kings
description: Greatest Keldon warlords, prophesied to rise at the Keldon Twilight.

description_citations.text: "Keldon Necropolis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Latulla is defeated in ritual combat by the keeper Gorsha, so the Witch Kings stay asleep.
timeline.quote: Latulla was defeated, so the Witch Kings were not awakened prematurely.

citation.text: "Keldon Necropolis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Keldon Twilight arrives and the Witch Kings rise and fight against the living Keldons.
timeline.quote: the Witch Kings rising up and instead fought against the living Keldons

citation.text: "Keldon Necropolis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Doyenne Tajamin strikes a Witch King, triggering a volcanic eruption and flood.
timeline.quote: Doyenne Tajamin striking one of the Witch Kings with her sacred cudgel

citation.text: "Keldon Necropolis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Latulla returns to Keld to push the warlords to awaken the Witch Kings, but is defeated in ritual combat by Gorsha at the Keldon Necropolis and exiled with her supporters.
timeline.quote: Latulla and her supporters were exiled from Keld to fight and die in foreign lands
